content: Build a purpose-built `gbauto-supabase` CLI (Printing Press pattern) as the single, isolated Supabase tool surface for every environment — Mac Mini, Windows dev, Linear CI, future per-client agents. Lives in services/gbauto_supabase/, installable via `uv tool install` so no global brew/npm dependency, no MCP per session, and one secret resolver everywhere.
